tasks.label: Find large files (>100MB, skip .git)
tasks.command: $root=(Get-Location).Path; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Directory -Exclude .git | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem $_ -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 100MB } } | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object @{n='Path';e={$_.FullName.Substring($root.Length+1)}}, @{n='MB';e={[math]::Round($_.Length/1MB,2)}}
